seoTitle: PNG to JPG Converter with Background Colour
metaDescription: Convert PNG, WebP or other images to JPEG and choose the colour that fills transparent areas, since JPEG has no transparency. Set the quality and convert...
intro: Convert PNG to JPG and pick the colour behind transparent areas.
why:
Drop in one or more images and choose the background colour and JPEG quality. JPEG has no transparency, so transparent pixels are filled with the colour you pick, white by default. Files are converted one by one in your browser.

JPEG is lossy. Text, logos and sharp edges can show small artefacts at low quality, so keep the original PNG if you may need it again.
howTo: Set the background colour as a hex value.
Download the JPEG files, or tick the ZIP box.
